title: Insufficient Evidence Incident Escalation
preconditions: No distinct error signatures identified in recent logs
All service health checks and dependencies report healthy status
Evidence is insufficient to isolate root cause with high confidence
steps: Do not execute speculative or disruptive restarts or rollbacks
Page primary on-call Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) and service owner
Enable elevated debug logging level on affected service
Maintain war-room monitoring until manual triaging begins
